reason: In src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/queue_consumer.py:86-93 the scan breaks at a missing offset, but mark_committed (lines 103-105) prunes all_offsets, so on the next 1s commit cycle min_offset is the first offset after the gap and start=max(last_committed+1, min_offset) skips it (100,102,103 commits 100, then 103 without 101). The tests that assert gap blocking (tests/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/test_queue_consumer.py:351-372 and test_thread_queue_parallel_offset_gaps in the patch) only hold because they check before the second cycle runs.
